item: U06 — U.S.–China treaty rate on dividends
was: The site's open item said: “The treaty text was not read in this pass. The dividend route is priced at the statutory 20% only.”
now: Treaty Article 9(2): where the recipient is the beneficial owner, Chinese tax on dividends “shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the dividends”. China's relief procedure (SAT Announcement 2019 No. 35) is self-assessed: give the information report form to the withholding agent and keep a U.S. residency certificate and beneficial-owner evidence. If the form is not submitted, the payer withholds under domestic law.
effect: The dividend route (L09) can carry 10% Chinese tax instead of 20%. At $400,000 that is $40,000 instead of $80,000 of Chinese tax — $39,916 less known cost at today's board. The U.S. side and the foreign tax credit are not modelled, so this is not a claim about your total burden.

was: The site's open item said: “The eCFR table gives USD 165,353. The statute's alternative of 50% of the account balance was not read in this pass and is not stated as verified.”
now: 31 U.S.C. § 5321(a)(5)(C)(i): the willful maximum is the greater of $100,000 or 50 percent of the account balance at the time of the violation. 31 CFR 1010.821 inflation-adjusts the $100,000 figure to $165,353 for penalties assessed on or after 2025-01-17.
effect: The 50% prong takes over once the balance exceeds $330,706. On a $400,000 balance the willful ceiling is $200,000, not $165,353. The site's own row understates the ceiling for balances above that threshold.

item: U16 — 2024 Capital Account Guidelines document list
was: The site's open item said: “Section 6.4 of 汇发〔2024〕12号 is known only through the SAFE Tianjin answer of 19 March 2026… whether the 2024 guidelines changed them was not checked.”
now: SAFE Hebei's official service guide for 移民财产转移购付汇核准 reproduces § 6.4.3.1 of 汇发〔2024〕12号: written application plus the 个人财产转移业务申请表, identity documents including the 户籍注销证明, income-source and property-right documents, the original tax certificate, and the agent agreement if one is used.
effect: The document list already on the site stands. Three operational facts are new: the approval takes 20 working days, the application is free, and the 《资本项目外汇业务核准件》 is valid 当次 — one transaction only, not a standing permission.
